ad_library.summary: SunSolar is running four active Meta ads, all opened on 21-23 November 2026, and every one of them sends the click to a bare http://fb.me/ redirect - a destination we cannot inspect and that carries no tracking parameters. The site itself does fire a Google Ads conversion tag (AW-18179174251) on the lead form, the WhatsApp links and both phone numbers, so the money spent on Google is measurable. Meta spend is not: there is no Meta Pixel anywhere in the served page, no GA4, and no GTM container, which means the four live Facebook ads produce leads SunSolar can count only by hand. The Google Ads Transparency Centre returns no advertiser record for sunsolar.info in India, so the Google Ads tag is currently collecting conversion data for an account that shows no live Google ads.

scope_note: The homepage was read directly and through the W3C checker's source view: head (lines 1-36) and the closing script block (lines 577-580, gsap, ScrollTrigger, script.js, tracking.js). tracking.js defines SUNSOLAR_CONVERSIONS and fires one Google Ads conversion action (AW-18179174251/3vm-CPqx27UcEOvewNxD) for the lead form, the WhatsApp link and both phone links - that is source-code evidence that the tag is installed and wired, not proof that a conversion has ever been recorded in the account. No Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, LinkedIn, Clarity or Hotjar script is present in the served HTML. The four Meta ads are live; the fb.me redirect hides their landing page from inspection.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
